maternity_terms_present.name: maternity_terms_present
maternity_terms_present.value: not "maternity_covered" or ("maternity_waiting_period_months" is not null and "maternity_limit" is not null)

amount_matches_kind.name: amount_matches_kind
amount_matches_kind.value:
("kind" = 'preauth' and "estimated_amount" is not null)
        or ("kind" in ('claim', 'reimbursement') and "billed_amount" is not null)
        or ("kind" = 'appeal')

has_content.name: has_content
has_content.value: "body_text" is not null or "payload" is not null or "template_id" is not null or "type" = 'media'

review_resolution_recorded.name: review_resolution_recorded
review_resolution_recorded.value: "status" not in ('accepted', 'edited', 'rejected') or "resolved_at" is not null

customer_event_view.name: customer_event_view
customer_event_view.definition:
select e.id, e.external_ref, e.policy_id, e.kind, e.policy_month, e.benefit_class,
         e.description, e.billed_amount, e.estimated_amount,
         e.outcome, e.reason_code, e.plan_pays, e.member_pays,
         e.member_explanation as explanation,
         e.calculation, e.created_at
  from servicing_event e

customer_policy_view.name: customer_policy_view
customer_policy_view.definition:
select p.id            as policy_id,
         p.policy_number,
         p.inception_date,
         p.status,
         pl.name         as plan_name,
         p.annual_premium,
         pe.full_name,
         pl.deductible,
         pl.outpatient_copay_pct,
         pl.network,
         pl.network_note,
         pl.annual_limit,
         pl.dental_optical,
         pl.maternity_covered,
         pl.maternity_waiting_period_months,
         pl.maternity_limit,
         pl.chronic_covered,
         pl.chronic_waiting_period_months,
         l.deductible_met,
         l.annual_paid,
         l.sublimit_used
  from policy p
  join plan   pl on pl.id = p.plan_id
  join person pe on pe.id = p.person_id
  left join benefit_ledger l on l.policy_id = p.id

ai_review_queue.name: ai_review_queue
ai_review_queue.definition:
select d.id            as ai_decision_id,
         d.decision_type,
         d.subject_type, d.subject_id,
         d.summary, d.confidence, d.uncertainty_reason,
         d.created_at,
         r.id            as review_task_id,
         r.priority_score,
         r.status        as review_status,
         m.model_id, m.prompt_version
  from ai_decision d
  left join review_task r on r.id = d.review_task_id
  left join model_run  m on m.id = d.model_run_id
  where d.status = 'proposed' and d.requires_review

application_field_provenance.name: application_field_provenance
application_field_provenance.definition:
select e.target_table, e.target_column, e.target_row_id,
         e.field_key, e.value_text, e.raw_span, e.method, e.confidence,
         c.channel, c.id as conversation_id, msg.provider_timestamp as said_at
  from extraction e
  join conversation c on c.id = e.conversation_id
  left join message msg on msg.id = e.message_id
